name: Global.String
description:
This module contains Titanium-only extensions for formatting data into locale-specific strings. 
The target locale is configured by the user in the device's system Settings.

methods.name: format

parameters.name: formatString
parameters.summary: An IEEE `printf`-style string, containing zero or more conversion specifications.

parameters.name: value
parameters.summary:
Values to substitute into the `formatString`.  The method expects a variable number
of `value` arguments, one for each `%` conversion specification in the format
string. Optional on Android.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.summary:
Formats a number into the currency format, including currency symbol, of the locale 
configured for the system.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.summary: Formats a date into the date format of the locale configured for the system.

parameters.name: format
parameters.summary: Date format to use. One of 'short', 'medium', 'long' or 'full'.

methods.name: formatDecimal
methods.summary:
Formats a number into the decimal format, including decimal symbol, of the locale 
configured for the system.
methods.description:
The localized string created by this method can be parsed be parsed back to a number
via the [Titanium.Locale.parseDecimal](api:Titanium.Locale#parseDecimal) method.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.summary: Locale string. For example, `en-US` for US English.

returns.summary:
String representation of the specified number, using a locale-specific decimal symbol, 
if required.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.summary: Formats a date into the time format of the locale configured for the system.
methods.description: On Android, this method returns the short format.

parameters.name: format
parameters.summary: Date format to use. One of 'short', 'medium', or 'long' (iOS only.)
